classification: Post hoc descriptive activation/source-stage analysis of fixed, independently audited DEVELOPMENT outcomes
method: Read saved JSON only; count assembly receipts at each recorded stage; compare physical (path,line)->exact text maps to the saved coverage-control response; classify each missing full evidence group at its first absent recorded stage. No producer, selector, index, model or numerical module is imported. Existing path/full-line evidence semantics are retained. Counts are row occurrences, not independent experimental units.

sole_regression.cause: Character-budget crowding, not retrieval absence: irrelevant top finalize grows from 2968 to 7444 chars. Only finalize plus a 4550-character prefix of extractDefs fit; resolveRef remains rawrank 6 and eligible 5 but never packs. The guarded connected condition returns the coverage reference and restores the hit.

interpretation: No new evidence group or complete query is recovered beyond the prior coverage control by any of the three new candidates. The two gains versus legacy are inherited from the existing control.

The joining rules really activate, but every accepted guarded union is clipped before its companion contributes novel source. Forward continuations restore only six line occurrences across two reused query units, including one absent case, from already-selected original windows.

Only one of the79 missing group occurrences is a representative-window deduplication loss; connected selection restores its full evidence at selectedrank11, still outside the eligible budget. Most missing groups are distinct-definition allocation/ranking or input-pool problems.

The scoped joining experiment is complete with a negative finding; no candidate qualifies, so retain defaults and do not consume the fresh repository. A future separately preregistered study should prioritize query-aspect complementary definition selection/ranking within8 results; whole-window concatenation is not supported by these results.
